extracted.name: Blue Cheese Potato Salad
extracted.description: This blue cheese potato salad recipe uses waxy red potatoes, tangy blue cheese, peppery green onions, and crunchy bacon bits for an unforgettable salad.
instruction_lines: Place potatoes into a large pot and cover with salted water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain, cool, and chop, leaving skins on. Set aside.
Meanwhile, cook bacon in a large, deep skillet over medium-high heat until evenly browned. Drain, crumble, and set aside.
Whisk green onions, oil, vinegar, black pepper, and salt together in a large bowl. Add potatoes, bacon, and cheese; toss to coat.
